notes.title: Update Information (July 11th, 2024)
notes.notes:
Survival Passes

Survival Passes will now change monthly and rotate through Seasons 1 through 4.
Although each Survival Pass: Premium Tier DLC will always be available for purchase, they are only active for the corresponding seasons.
When Exoprimal reenters a given season, progression from the previous instance of that season will be carried over.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/849e6632868e966b729520202b81bef397c1f647.jpg
Also, a discounted set of passes for all four seasons is now available for purchase in the special Exoprimal Survival Pass: Premium Tier Pack.
Don't miss out on this opportunity to save!
 


Weekly Campaigns and Missions

Additionally, from now on, campaigns and routine missions will occur on a fixed schedule.

Check here for more details.
https://info.exoprimal.com/pages/other_20240705_001

New Content and Features

Beta Variant Exosuits
・Zephyr β: Boost Claws
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/3fee6979cffeb16aa2a4f5a67fb0147076ad2c11.png

・Vigilant β: Bowhunter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/07e4df3030d304cc578e60f62c5004bda4d9aad6.png

・Krieger β: Blitz Cannon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/212cf25e0ab133ebb77bca16ee8b4796aa1af728.png

・Murasame β: Windcaller
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/f46c4ecf8a6e85917b3830b79a9c2e41f726838a.png

・Witchdoctor β: Plasma Shot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a855278541c7d81a69e592d93bb0384f4eaa0022.png

・Nimbus β: Wild Bomb
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/f2f85e794aba03b0c386f34eb40d8f39d5e99ac2.png

The weapons equipped to these β variant series sport different attributes from conventional exosuits, changing up the way you fight.
These Beta variant series can be purchased with BikCoins once the Alpha variant series suit reaches level 10. 


New Rigs
・Mortar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/86f0183cf150a20726d4e9c6918c8ecf8d167252.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/c803b7b91f18505b75dea50e9afa7373fe638c0f.png
These new rigs can be purchased with BikCoins once you reach the required player level.

New Modules 

Base Modules 
Exotic Module
When an Overdrive is activated, the player triggering it and Friendly Exofighters equipped with this Module will both receive a temporary boost to attack strength.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/f688a61dc2fcf51c6840199ac062ff08fdbabdc6.png

This module is built with Overdrives in mind.
Since this module also activates among team members with the same module equipped, mindful coordination with your allies is key to making the most of it.

Ace Module
The Ace Module is for those who never stop fighting.
When a fighter equipped with this module has the highest score among all fighters upon reaching a set score threshold, that player will receive every buff. However, they'll remained detected by hostile Exofighters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/06279a65c05f05683d73ad91cd95d2a8c8345b1b.png

This module lets you power up based on your performance.
As long as you have the highest score, your attack, defense, and movement speed will increase.
Aim to get the highest score before anyone else.

Action Modules
Z - Impact Strike
Reduces the damage of Linear Strike and the like in exchange for emitting a shockwave upon activation.
This shockwave will explode after reaching a distance, blowing back the enemy considerably.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/e6d6b43cdef1434c102de3aa25350f9098b1d3f5.png

This module alters the properties of the Zephyr Series' Linear Strike.
The shockwave has the capability of snagging Hostile Exofighters and small enemies, making it easy to link with other skills.

K Enhance Dome
Reduces the cooldown time for all skills for both the player who activates it and any allies while in the Dome Shield.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/f69438e8da9ce962735f9930412245efc81dc1b8.png

This module alters the properties of the Krieger Series' Dome Shield.
This increases the fighting capability of your team by allowing you and your allies to use skills more frequently.


Various other Modules have also been added.

The new Base Modules and Action Modules 
change how the Exosuits fight.

These new Modules are being added to Player Level Rewards and Beta Variant Series Suit Level Rewards.

Neo Triceratops Savage Gauntlet Boss Battle{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/65c453288a860a8966cf8c7cba940e3d2c809c8d.png 
Try to finish the excruciatingly difficult 5-person PvE Missions.
Boss battles will be regularly added into the Savage Gauntlet schedule so you can enjoy a variety of gameplay encounters.
* Check the information site for details on the Savage Gauntlet.

New Mode: Time Loop Rebellion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/39403399757d215072c64dfd3441136185417d61.png

The Time Loop Rebellion is new high-difficulty PvE content that remixes the final battle against the Leviathan.
Play repeatedly to earn Rebellion Points, which are used to obtain rewards.
Work in groups of up to 10 fighters to win the battle.

Time Loop Rebellion is only available for a limited time.
The initial period is as follows.

April 26th, 2024 (Fri) 3:00 a.m. UTC - April 30th, 2024 (Tue) 2:59 a.m. UTC
April 25th, 2024 (Thu) 8:00 p.m. PDT - April 29th, 2024 (Mon) 7:59 p.m. PDT
April 25th, 2024 (Thu) 11:00 p.m. EDT - April 29th, 2024 (Mon) 10:59 p.m. EDT

New Mode: Custom Match
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/730ad3242c784942ad646c229089978fda0badd4.png

We've added Custom Match mode, letting you send passcodes to other players to take on the dino menace together!
Enjoy wargames with friends across platforms, playing in game modes, missions, and fields of your choice.

Check here for more details about the Custom Matches.
Introducing a New Mode: Custom Match

New War Chest Rewards 
[code]- EXOSUIT SKINS
- WEAPON SKINS
- DECALS
- CHARMS
- STAMPS
- EMOTES
- EMBLEMS
- BACKGROUNDS [/code]
New Medals 

New Awards 
For the Glory
This special award is obtained by reaching Level 3 for a certain number of Medal Awards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/36b8a7903b6840b9d116abcf19bf1e55c4dccc01.png

High-end Exofighter
This special award is obtained by achieving an extremely high score in one game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/6d1d65335014dddd16e705c5b6e6d1e46183228f.png

Legendary Pilot
This special award is obtained by reaching Suit Level 50 for 30 Exosuits.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/0cb9ac0dd85aa37117a19d0937c8fc271c532fc8.png

Other Awards have been added.


 Game Balance Adjustments

Exosuit Adjustments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a2b035180f9b281d965fffa0d82c787df51dd287.png
Exosuit: Zephyr α 

 There was a disparity between the Primary Attack range and the Skill attack range, making it difficult to inflict instantaneous damage. As a result, the Primary Attack damage reduction has been reduced to allow damage to be dealt even when in closer than optimum range.
Also, there were many cases where, when fighting against shooting-type exosuits, you would lose before doing any damage. Because of this, its health has been reexamined.

Health has been increased from 350 to 400.
 The distance-based damage reduction for the Dragon Chakram Primary Attack has been softened.

Exosuit: Barrage 

Out of all of the exosuits, this exosuit was designed to excel at dealing massive damage amongst many targets. However, due to Burning Heart's instant firepower, it was able to deal massive damage to one enemy target.
As a result, Burning Heart's damage has been decreased. The risky health reduction trade-off in exchange for that instant firepower has also been made more severe to adjust its practical applications during gameplay. Additionally, the default Barrage's Health has been reexamined, as well.

Furthermore, the Stun Grenade's cooldown has been extended, as when paired with the B - Boost Grenade, it had a high rate of preventing Hostile Exofighters from moving. Additionally, to make it more effective against enemy dinosaurs, each hit will deal a higher stun value, making it much easier to stun medium-size dinosaurs and above.

Reduced Health from 500 to 450. (Default suit only.)
 The damage of the Burning Heart Overdrive has been decreased. VS Dinosaurs: From 5000 to 4000. Versus Fighters: From 1600 to 1000. (Applies to all Barrage Series.)
The health reduction of Barrage when using the Burning Heart Overdrive has been increased. (Applies to all Barrage Series.)
Stun Grenade's cooldown time has been increased from 10 to 14 seconds. (Applies to all Barrage Series.)
Hitting a dinosaur's head with a Stun Grenade is much more likely to stun them. (*Applies to all Barrage Series.)


Exosuit: Krieger 

Due to the long length of Dome Shield's cooldown, it was difficult to protect allies as a Tank Suit immediately after its destruction.
By reducing the cooldown of Dome Shield, we expect that it'll be quick to recover after it has been destroyed, making it both easier to use and giving Tank Suits more opportunities to shine in combat.

 Dome Shield's cooldown has been reduced from 23 to 19 seconds.


RIG 

On Rigs with high durability, shields can frequently be used in combination with the Rig Loading Module.
However, it was easy to defend against attacks from both Dinosaurs and Hostile Exofighters, making this Rig used more frequently than others.
As a result, we have increased the Shield's cooldown in order to change when it's selected. We expect this to make other Rigs more viable options to choose, as well as enabling Tank Suits to flourish more often.

 The cooldown of Rig Shields has been extended from 17 to 24 seconds.


Dominator

Sometimes Triceratopses summoned by Dominators had difficulty in defeating enemies due to reasons such as there being few locations for Hostile Exofighters to fall.
To account for this, the damage that Hostile Exofighters take when hitting a wall is increased. These adjustments make it so that the Dominator is both reliable and viable to use on any field.

 Increased damage when a Triceratops summoned by a Dominator knocks a Hostile Exofighter into a wall: From 400 to 600.


Game Mode Adjustments

 In Dino Survival, when PVP Priority is selected for the Final Mission Priority Setting, rules for Escape, Neo T. Rex Battle, and Neo Triceratops Battle rules will not be included.
 The conditions for Capcom Collab Missions have been lowered.
The required Score and Suit EXP for certain Medals has been increased.
 A wider variety of contributions will now be commended more often on the results screen.
 when a time-out occurs during Savage Gauntlet matching, The game will start with a Bot replacing The player who timed out.


Bug Fixes
Exosuit Adjustments
Exosuit: Vigilant

Fixed a bug where the firing speed of Vigilant α's Primary Attack would sometimes vary based on framerate.


Exosuit: Roadblock

Fixed a bug where after a counter blast is fired while equipped with the R03 - Road Forger module for the Roadblock β and the exosuit is then unequipped, the counter blast damage would increase.
An issue was fixed where the effect of R - Intimidation for the Roadblock series would not sometimes work properly depending on the target's distance.


Exosuit: Murasame

Fixed a bug where damage would not accumulate under specific circumstances even when blocking while using Vajra Counter.


Exosuit: Skywave

Fixed a bug where when Skywave α's lightning bolt is blocked, the blocking player's damage would incorrectly vary based on the direction they were facing.


Other

Fixed a bug for some Action Modules where the damage-boosting effect would not correctly apply to α and β series exosuits.
Fixed a bug where the controller would not vibrate when taking certain attacks.
Increased the number of anti-aliasing options.


Enemy Adjustments

Fixed a bug for Rathalos and Neo Triceratops battles where enemies would sometimes become transparent. 
Fixed a bug for the Neo Triceratops battle where players could become stuck in certain positions.
Fixed a bug where incorrect damage values would be displayed when a Kinetic Rock would reflect off of a Neo Triceratops' shield.
Fixed a bug where deploying a shield with Roadblock β while near a Sniper Neosaur could sometimes trigger a self-destruct.


UI Adjustments

The text for how to obtain The The Influence Emote was fixed.
Other typos in the game text have been fixed.


Achievements/Trophies

Fixed a bug where the "Cretaceous Eradicator" achievement/trophy wouldn't be awarded despite the Battle Records listing 100,000-plus dinosaurs being defeated.


Other minor bugs have also been fixed.


The Exoprimal team appreciates your interest and support, and we hope to see you in the wargames!

Join the hunt in Exoprimal!

Our second Capcom Collab is slated to release its set of collaborative content with Monster Hunter alongside Title Update 3!
Check here for more details about the collaboration.
The Monster Hunter Collaboration Begins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/b3fc45a2cf5eea6be7c969d83ff531b404f223d1.png

The Monster Hunter Collaboration will be available for a limited time.

January 19th (Fri) 3:00 a.m. UTC - February 13 (Tue) 2:59 a.m. UTC
January 18th (Thu) 7:00 p.m. PST - February 12 (Mon) 6:59 p.m. PST
January 18th (Thu) 10:00 p.m. EST - February 12 (Mon) 9:59 p.m. EST


New Content and Features
A new map has been added.
Jungle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/153e6c2de0440278830d745803b9a381cc0d2d38.png

A new Final Mission has been added.
Eliminate the Neo Triceratops
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/65c453288a860a8966cf8c7cba940e3d2c809c8d.png

Neo Triceratops is a neosaur comparable in power to Neo T. Rex and Durban.
Work in groups of up to 10 fighters to take it down.

Introducing Beta variant exosuits!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/4a6b3baf94b8dd2b6429b197436af92c4c8091a2.png

Deadeye β: Energy MG
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/f834b32a24d24c96ae48f840a619e046bf2434ea.png

Barrage β: Fire Spray
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/3ece3e2877c55f37e15571d8cff0b7497e1a5759.png

Roadblock β: Counter Shield
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/b956d516a54b327a64efbf920f5d76531f6b188f.png

Skywave β: Lifeline
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/5145e69a419e22108037eacb69e70d620567c789.png


The weapons equipped to these Beta variant series sport different attributes from your conventional exosuits, changing up the way you handle yourself in battle.
These Beta variant series can be purchased with BikCoins once the Alpha variant series suit reaches level 10. 


New rigs have been added.
Stealth
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/50a3e4337362975eb82b3b18d69b4eb9d8e49b1d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/c6d631ce38f0c302f825ca3682b10780895cdc80.png

These new rigs can be purchased with BikCoins once you reach the required player level.

New Modules have been added. 

Base Module 
Hi-Xol Reusable Module
The Overdrive Gauge will charge when Overdrive is used.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/33e64b9a54e10e824e6508f0a4c4ae9536cf5c24.png

This module revolves around Overdrives.
The gauge won't empty out even when an Overdrive is used, enabling you to fire off the next Overdrive even sooner.

Durban Module
This module lets you fire at enemies as tenaciously as Durban himself.
Grants a boost to attack power and movement speed upon respawning after a knockout. The enemy fighter that previously defeated you will also be detected.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/3e2fd3315563ec0e2ed70235483bcaf590a11a31.png

This module offers enhanced support for direct combat against enemy fighters.
Not only will you respawn in a powered up state after being defeated, but the targeted enemy will be visible to all allies.

Action Modules
D - Compact Grenade
Adds 1 additional use for the Rifle Grenade and reduces it cooldown time in exchange for a smaller explosion range and less damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/fc54604ae4c175e49250b0cce0c932de99cd907f.png

This module alters the properties of the Deadeye Rifle Grenade.
The Rifle Grenade can be used more frequently, amplifying Deadeye's overall adaptability even higher.

S - Graviton Echo
Generates a shockwave with powerful suction when your primary attack hits the gravity cluster of the Graviton Cage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/cdace6c6209e9cdf8157b637c2b8195ad15073a6.png

This module alters the properties of the Skyline Graviton Cage.
When combined with your primary attack, it grants better control over enemies caught inside of the Graviton Cage.


Other Modules have been added.
The new Base Modules and Action Modules change how the default and Alpha Variant series Exosuits do battle.

These new Modules are added to Player Level Rewards and Beta Variant Series Suit Level Rewards.


New rewards have been added to the War Chest. 
[code]- EXOSUIT SKINS
- WEAPON SKINS
- DECALS
- CHARMS
- STAMPS
- EMOTES
- EMBLEMS
- BACKGROUNDS [/code]
New medals have been added. 

New awards have been added. 

Some menus and portions of the UI have been slightly adjusted.
[code]A button that displays Suit Details such as Active Skills and the like has been added to the Suit Status screen and Rig/Module screens.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/d4f6f0b97f0953dda5f5c745973637b00d8bf704.jpg

A function has been added to check the Modules attached to each Exosuit in the Suit Selection screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/23b07bd3be1c09d002e8455f5d33f2fad1a70e2a.jpg

・A function has been added that lists the names and unlock requirements for awards currently equipped to award plates seen on the player list of the results screen, buddy player information, etc.
[/code]

Bug Fixes & Balance Adjustments

Exosuit Adjustments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a2b035180f9b281d965fffa0d82c787df51dd287.png
Exosuit: Krieger 

 Fixed a bug where Krieger's Stunlock Missile would not inflict damage or paralyze small dinosaurs after a direct attack.

Exosuit: Witchdoctor 

 Fixed a bug on PlayStation®5 where the firing sound effects of ally Witchdoctor α players would continue to play.
 Fixed a bug where Witchdoctor's Feed would not properly restore energy after being used on a small dinosaur, which could lead to unintended issues.


Other

 Fixed a bug where the Repairs EX medal could only be obtained with the recovery skill of either Witchdoctor or Witchdoctor α.
 Fixed a bug where the High-End Skywave award could not be obtained with Skywave α.


Game Mode Adjustments

 Adjustments have been made in Dino Survival so that Missions and Dino Swarms matching the story progression will more readily appear.
 Adjustments have been made in Dino Survival so greater priority will be given to new fields based on story progression.
 Adjustments have been made in Dino Survival to the matching rate of select missions that occur only in the story.
 Bots will be equipped with modules based on the situation.
 Restrictions will be placed on players who leave in the middle of a Savage Gauntlet.
[code]- If a player leaves in the middle of the Savage Gauntlet, a restriction will be placed upon the next matching.
- If this restriction is active, a countdown timer will be displayed, during which, you will be unable to initiate Savage Gauntlet matching.
- Matching for a Savage Gauntlet will not start if a buddy member has a time limit.
- No restrictions will be placed upon you if you leave midway after another player has left.
- If the 5 players are buddies, there are no restrictions placed for leaving midway.[/code]

UI Adjustments

 Fixed a bug where damage would sometimes be displayed incorrectly when a small dinosaur received multiple attacks in the same frame.
 Typos in the game text have been fixed.


Other smaller bugs have also been fixed.


The Exoprimal team appreciates your interest and support, and we hope to see you in the wargame!

notes.title: Season 2 Kicks Off October 18 with Title Update 2!
notes.notes:
Here's the latest information on Season 2 of Exoprimal! Check out the trailer below for a first look at contents coming in Title Update 2.

[previewyoutube=GVXw1-39eH8;full][/previewyoutube]
Exofighters will tasked to survive Leviathan's wargames with an array of new contents, including the Ocean Platform stage, the Edge Strike and Drone rigs, and a final mission called Escape where opposing teams join forces in ten-player co-op to complete mission objectives. Season 2 will also introduce seasonal events for Halloween and the winter holidays, giving players a chance to snag exclusive exosuit skins for a limited time. The Street Fighter 6 collaboration contents will be available as part of Title Update 2 as well, ushering in exosuit skins, decals, charms, stamps, and emotes inspired by the Street Fighter series. Exofighters can get their hands on these items by playing Dino Survival a specific number of times or purchasing paid cosmetic sets. 

Season 2 kicks off October 18 with the release of Title Update 2. See you in the wargames!

notes.title: Exoprimal release date, gameplay, trailers
notes.notes:
When is the Exoprimal release date? It may not be the next Dino Crisis, much as some of us wish for a return of that series, but Exoprimal is looking to be its own savage beast of a game. In Exoprimal, teams fight to be the best-performing squad by competing in objective-based missions where they take on swarms of dinosaurs.
However, this action-adventure game is more than just an excuse to slaughter prehistoric creatures. By the time the Exoprimal release date rolls around, players will need to cooperate with the sentient AI, Leviathan, who is gathering data on the performance of the Exofighters. Here is everything you need to know about the latest dinosaur game from Capcom.

notes.title: Hammerheads HQ – March Open Beta Test & PvE Content Update
notes.notes:
Hey Exofighters,

Welcome to Hammerheads HQ, our new community blog post for Exoprimal! 

These posts will be another way for us to share Exoprimal news and info directly with you, delve into game details ahead of launch and more!

To get things rolling, we’ll be taking a look at some of the numbers and interesting finds from our March Open Beta, as well as highlighting the recent news we shared on our social media that gave an exciting update about content that you’ll be able to dive right into when Exoprimal launches in July.


Open Beta Breakdown!

As many of you know, in March we held our first Open Beta Test for Exoprimal, following our Closed Beta Test at the end of 2022.

Players from across the globe rallied to Leviathan’s invite to try the wargames, and well, you all certainly made yourselves busy! Let’s take a look at how that went down…

Dinosaurs Slayed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/c78dc4d10b27bbd9bf983ad36e9f42fe1e0f7383.jpg

Yep, you read that correctly, in the Open Beta alone, Exofighters slayed a staggering 382 million Raptors! No matter how many came through those portals, you held the line and pushed back the ravenous super swarms that hungered for a nibble on your Exosuit! Don’t worry though, we know Leviathan has plenty more Raptors where they came from, eagerly awaiting to make your acquaintance.

On top of the Raptors you reintroduced to extinction, you managed to topple a very respectable amount of large dinos, with players toppling over 1.2 million Triceratops and just shy of 725k T-Rex takedowns. Taking down a T-Rex or Triceratops is a real show of teamwork, so well played there! (Trust us, we know exactly how it feels to be isolated by a T-Rex for a quick visit to the respawn screen…)

Dominators Activated

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/d9fe2dfa91a5e7235005f37ab9736b5ff5e4016f.jpg

Throughout the Beta’s wargames, Leviathan was kind enough to give Exofighters the occasional opportunity to harness the power of Dominators, allowing you to pay a little visit to the enemy team whilst controlling a T-Rex, Triceratops or Carnotaurus!  

It looks like lots of you eagerly volunteered to take a dino for a spin and cause chaos for your rivals. We can only assume this is because you wanted to help them practice fighting against such serious threats, and not because you wanted an exo-snack…

Popular Exosuits

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/4e852fb62e0fbf11cb12b6d9239ac528554a3eb9.jpg

With 10 unique Exosuits to choose from, split between 3 different roles, we were keen to see which ones you gravitated to throughout the Open Beta. Overall, there was a fairly even spread of Exosuit usage, with players finding their favourites, adapting to the current combat situation to help secure the win… and stay alive!

However, out of the Assault, Tank and Support Roles we saw three Exosuits take the crown when it came to popularity and usage rates: 

Assault – Zephyr carved its way to the top!
Tank – Murasame countered all opposition!
Support – Skywave controlled the battle from above!

Were these Exosuits part of your selection, or were you rocking something else? Let us know which suits really caught your attention!

Top Rigs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/02ce2c221ce1ab7809dfa4126c6b132417e55d0e.jpg

Alongside your choice of Exosuit, you were able to augment your combat capabilities on the go with a selection of Rigs! 

Judging by the results of the most popular Rigs, it looks like many of you are very bold, opting to charge into the fray with the Drill Fist to unleash powerful melee damage.

The crowd-controlling Blade and the ranged Cannon took a respectful second and third place!

Exofighters Defeated

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/4e94edc8776274b698d8ac0ded5f1fe99b691f58.jpg

During the Beta’s wargames, it wasn’t just the dinosaurs you had to be wary of, but your rival Exofighters! 

Whilst the dinosaurs themselves took a chunk out of new recruits, you also provided some valuable combat lessons to your fellow Exofighters with a combined total of 567,923 Exofighter defeats in PvPvE combat scenarios.


PvE Content Update

The Open Beta Test not only gave the community an opportunity to try just part of the Exoprimal experience, but also give us your thoughts and feedback!

The team were grateful for everyone that took the time to share their comments with us and saw that many of you were keen to learn more about PvE and customisation experiences in Exoprimal.

We originally shared the following information on April 14th via the Exoprimal website and social media accounts, but in-case you missed it, here’s an overview:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/12516feeb73a27e6fba27503c6a2ac2c647529f5.png

What does this mean? Well, the Beta was but a snapshot of the game, and there’s plenty more to come, especially for those who are keen to further customise their Exosuit for combat, or looking to focus on the PvE aspects of Exoprimal! 

You can read the full website post by clicking here.

We’ll be sharing more information on the above as we move toward launch on July 14th, we look forward to hearing what you think of it!


Stand by for combat mission

That wraps up our first Hammerheads HQ post!

We hope you enjoyed taking a look at the Open Beta breakdown, as well as our community update on PvE and other content that you’ll be able to enjoy from launch on July 14! 

Stay tuned for our next community post, but in the meantime, follow Exoprimal on Twitter and like us on Facebook for the latest Exoprimal news. 

Thanks, Exofighters!

- Exoprimal Community Team

notes.title: Exoprimal Full Release Info and a Thank-You to All Open Beta Test Participants
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who participated in the Exoprimal open beta test.
Our team gained a great deal of data from exofighter survey responses and social media. We'll put this feedback to good use and make Exoprimal the best game it can be!
While the open beta allowed players to experience some of the missions available in the Dino Survival mode, Exoprimal's full release will feature the following content for players to enjoy.


Missions without direct combat between players where victory is determined by clearing the PvE objectives as fast as possible
Cutscenes and an Analysis Map where players can explore Exoprimal's story and the mysteries surrounding Leviathan and parallel worlds
Story-related missions in Dino Survival
10-player co-op missions with a variety of objectives and even fiercer dinosaurs
A variety of maps like Dam and Volcanic Base
5-player missions that rotate weekly with global leaderboards for fastest completion time
Equipment called Modules that allow for deeper customization of exosuit capabilities
Exosuit skins, weapon skins, decals, emotes, and other cosmetic options
In-game medals and awards for completing certain challenges, like blocking a certain amount of damage as a Tank suit


We also plan on supporting Exoprimal with title updates after its release.


Exosuit variants that use different equipment for different play styles, like Deadeye with a burst-fire rifle that can also be used as a shotgun
Updates with each season that add more game content
Collaborations with other Capcom titles


We'd like to thank everyone once again for participating in the open beta test and leaving such great feedback.
Be sure to check Exoprimal's official website and social media accounts for the latest news and information.

The Exoprimal team appreciates your interest and support, and we hope to see you in future wargames!
